name: Yuderkys Espinosa Miñoso
shortBio: Afro-Dominican decolonial feminist philosopher and co-founder of GLEFAS who critiqued the "coloniality of feminist reason" for universalizing white bourgeois subjectivity.
centralQuestion: Why does hegemonic feminism reproduce colonial racism when it treats gender as separable from racialization and capitalist modernity?

keyWorks.title: De por qué es necesario un feminismo descolonial
keyWorks.description: Systematic critique of Eurocentric feminist epistemology and articulation of anti-racist decolonial feminism.
